sources.title: Urdatorn/sphragis-alm-olmo3-greek-7b-diodorus-siculus · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Each model is a full further-pretraining of Urdatorn/olmo3-7b-ancient-greek on one author's Sphragis training sentences only; a sentence is attributed to whichever of the seventeen models finds it least surprising. This model was trained on Diodorus Siculus: 1,000 sentences, 184,560 scored tokens from the sentence_1 training split.

sources.title: Urdatorn (Albin Thörn Cleland) - Hugging Face

sources.title: OLMo : Accelerating the Science of Language Models
sources.snippet: We believe that full access to open language models for the research community is critical to the scientific study of these models, their strengths and weaknesses, and their biases and risks.
